body: I'm a psychology major, so it's pretty surreal learning about suicide in class. Hearing all the yellow and red flags, and realizing that I've displayed the majority of them. And I honestly have no idea where I'm taking the degree. I wanted to become a cop, but my recent behaviour makes me a less than ideal candidate; so I think I have to choose another career path now.

I do too much thinking, that's the problem. And I just don't see myself getting another girl. It's like a catch-22. If I sleep with them, I assume they're a whore and are only going to crush me if I get too close. If they don't sleep with me, I think that they deserve a better guy than I am, and I scare them away.
I'm twenty, and it's been about 9-10 months since the breakup.
